newsitem.title: JAPAN: New Japan 3-month CDs issued at 0.54 pct - traders.
newsitem.headline: New Japan 3-month CDs issued at 0.54 pct - traders.

text.p: New three-month certificates of deposit (CDs) were issued at 0.54 percent on Wednesday, up from 0.53 percent on Tuesday, money traders in Tokyo said.
About 170 billion yen worth were issued, they added.
Three-month CDs were last issued at 0.54 percent on August 30, 1996.
CD rates are facing upward pressure as a massive amount of CDs are due to mature before the current fiscal year ends on March 31, traders said.
